chapter.verse: Zeisu in mun khatah thu ngen a, a tawp khit ciangin a nungzuite khat in, “Topa aw, Johan in ama nungzuite thunget nading ahilh mah bangin, kote zong hong hilh in,” ci-in a ngen hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in thu na nget uh ciangin hih bangin na ngen un: ‘Pa aw, Nangma min siangtho ta hen; Na Gam hong piang ta hen;
Ni simin ka khamkhop ding uh an hong pia in;
Ko tungah hong mawhte ka maisak uh bangin, kote mawhna zong hong maisak ta in; Kheemna hong thuaksak kei in,’ ci-in na ngen un,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Note khatpeuh in lawm nei a, zankim lai takin ama innah pai a, ‘Lawm aw, keima lawmte khat hong zin a, kei kiangah hong tung zo hi.
Amah ka vak nading bangmah om lo ahih ciangin, khomun pum thum hong leitawisak in,’ a ci hi.
A lawmpa in inn sung panin, ‘Kei hong bawlsia kei in. Tu-in kong kikhak zo hi. Ka tate tawh ka lum khin zo uh hi. Kei thoin nang kong pia zo kei ding hi,’ a ci ding hiam?
Ke’n kong cih-inah ama lawmpa ahih man-inah, thoin a pia kei zongin, ngen teitei ahih manin thoin a deih teng khempeuh a pia ding hi.”
“Khatvei ka cih-inah, ngen un. Na nget uh leh, hong pia ding hi. Zong un, Na zon’ uh leh, na mu ding uh hi. Kongkhak kiu un. Na kiuh uh leh, hong kihon’ ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a ngente khempeuh in a ngah ding uh hi. A zongte khempeuh in a mu ding uh hi. A kiute khempeuh ading kongkhak a hon’ ding hi.
A ta in khomun ngen leh, suang a pia ding, ngasa ngen leh, gul a pia ding,
aktui ngen leh, aikam a pia ding note lakah kua a om hiam?
Note in mi gilo na hi napi-un na tate uh a hoih na piak uh leh, tua sangin vantungah a om na Pa un a ngen mite Kha Siangtho hong pia zaw ding hilo ahi hiam?” ci-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in a pau thei lo dawi a hawlkhia hi. Dawi a paikhiat khit ciangin, a pau thei lopa a pau thei hi.
Mihonpite in lamdang a sa uh hi. Ahih hangin mi kimkhat in, “Amah in Beelzebub suangin dawite a hawlkhia hi,” a ci uh hi.
Kimkhat in zong ze-et nuamin vantung pan lim a ngen uh hi.
Zeisu in amau lungsim ngaihsutna thei-in, “Gam sung mi kilem loin a kikhen gam khempeuh in kisia ding hi. Inn khat zong inn dang tawh kilem loin a kikhen leh, a puk ding hi.
Keimah in Beelzebub suangin dawite ka hawlkhia hi, ci-in note’n nong gen man-unah Satan in amah leh amah kilem loin a kikhen leh, ama gam bangci a kip zo ding hiam?
Keimah in Beelzebub suangin dawite hawlkhia leng na tate un kua suangin dawite a hawlkhia ding uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin, amaute in note tungah thukhen dingte ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin, Pasian’ khutme tawh dawite ka hawlkhiat leh, Pasian’ Gam in note kiangah hong tung zo hi.
Mi thahat in hiam tawi-in ama inn tualah a cin lai takin ama sumte a bit hi.
Ahih hangin amah sangin a hatzaw mi hong pai a, a zawh khit ciangin, amah in a muan a hiamte sut a, a sumte la-in a hawm ding hi.
Keimah tawh a kipawl lote in keima langkhat ah a pang hi. Keimah tawh a khawmkhawm lote in a kithehthangsak hi.”
“A kihhuai dawi in mi sung pan a paikhiat khit ciangin, mun keuna-ah vakin khawl nading a zong hi.
A muh loh ciangin, ‘Ka paikhiatna inn lamah ciahkik ning,’ ci-a a pai leh, a tun’ ciangin tua inn awng a, kiphiat a, kipuah a, om a mu hi.
Tua ciangin pai a, amah sangin a gilo zaw dawi sagih va sam a, tua pa sungah a lut uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin, tua pa a pian’ nunung pen in a pian’ masak sangin a sia zaw hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in tua thu a gen lai takin, mihonpi lak panin numei khat in, “Nang hong paii gil leh na teep nawi in thupha a ngah ding hi,” ci-in a kiko hi.
Zeisu in, “Pasian thu za a, a mangte in thupha a ngah zaw ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Mihonpite in Zeisu kiangah a kikhop lai takun amah in, “Hih khang mite in mi gilote ahi uh hi. Amau in lim a zon’ uh hangin Jonah lim longal, lim dang amau tungah a kilak kei ding hi.
Jonah in Nineveh khuapihte tungah lim ahih bangin, Mihing Tapa in hih khang mite tungah lim ahi ding hi.

Khanglam gam kumpinu in thu a khen ciangin tu-a khang mite langkhat ah ding a, amaute a mawhsak ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in Solomon’ lungpilna thu ngai dingin, leimong panin a hong pai hi. Hih lai takah Solomon sangin a lianzaw mi khat a om hi.

Thu a khen ni ciangin Nineveh khua mite in tu-a khang mite langkhat ah ding-in a mawhsak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Jonah in thu a hilh manin amau mawhna a kisikkik uh hi. Hih lai takah Jonah sangin a lianzaw mi khat a om hi.”
“Kuamah in mei a vak khit uh ciangin buliahna-ah a koih kei a; seeng zong a khuh kei hi. A lut mite in meivak a muh nadingun kho sangah a vak hi.
Na mittang in na pumpi’ meivak ahi hi. Na mit a vak leh, na pumpi zong a vak kim ding hi. Na mit a man’ leh, na pumpi khempeuh zong a mial ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, na sungah a om khuavak in khuamial ahi hiam, hi lo hiam na en in.
Tua ahih ciangin, mun khat beek mial loin, na pumpi a vak leh, meivak’ vang tang in nang khuavak a hong pia bangin, na pumpi in khuavak tawh a kidim ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu a gen lai takin Farisaite khat in, Zeisu an vak dingin a sap leh, pai a, an ne dingin a sabuai ah a tu hi.
Zeisu in an a nek ma-in a kisil loh Farisaipa in a muh ciangin lamdang a sa hi.
Topa in, “No Faraisaite in hai leh dalkuangte a pua lam na silsiang uh hangin, na sung lam uh ah ngongtatna leh gitlohna tawh na kidim uh hi.
No mi pilote aw, a pualam a bawlpa in a sunglam zong bawl hilo ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin kuang sunglam a om nate mizawngte na pia un. Tua bang na hih uh leh, na khempeuh note mai-ah a siangtho ding hi.”

“Farisaite aw, note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leengmasel leh anis leh meh namkim sehsawm suah sehkhat na piak uh hangin, aman thukhenna leh Pasian itna na nusia uh hi. Adangte tang lo tuan loin, hihte zong tan’ ding kilawm hi.
Farisaite aw, note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kikhopna inn sungah tokhom sang bel ahi zongin, sumbuk ah zahtakna tawh hopihna ahi zongin na deih uh hi.
Note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a kilang lo hankhuk tawh kibang na hi uh hi. A tungah a pai mite in han om ci-in a thei kei uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Thukham siate khat in, “Sia aw, tua bang na gen ciangin ko zong na hong taai hi,” a cih ciangin,
Zeisu in, “No thukham siate aw, no zong gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a puak hak van midangte na suat uh hangin, na khutme khat nangawnun na lawng nuam kei uh hi.
Note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na pu na pate un a thah Pasian’ kamsangte’ han na bawl uh a, tua ahih ciangin na pu na pate’ hihsa nate thei-in na awi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in Pasian’ kamsangte a that uh a, note in amau han bawlin teci na pang uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Pasian’ lungpilna in, ‘Kamsangte leh sawltakte amaute kiangah ka sawl ding hi. Amau in tuate kimkhat that uh a, a bawlsia ding uh hi!’

Tua ahih ciangin Abel’ si akipan biakna tau leh biakna innpi kikal a, kithat Zekhariah’ si dongin, leitung pian’ akipan a kibuasa Pasian’ kamsangte khempeuh’ si in hih khang mite tungah a kingen ding hi.
Ahi hi. Ke’n kong cih-inah, tua si tu lai khang mite tungah a kisiik ding hi.
No Thukham siate aw, gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in lungpilna’ konghon’na na lakhia uh hi. No lah lut loin, a lut nuamte zong na kham uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in tua mun pan a paikhiat lai takin, laitheite leh Farisaite in nakpi-in hansuahin,
ama kam pan mat nading a pang uh a, kam tampi a gen nadingin thu tampi a dong kawikawi uh hi.
